findings.message: Detected 2 matching img entries with the same source/start/duration.
findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#file" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: <section id="s1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="s1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 4 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "CSV" at 25 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
